senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bearing good fruit, (literally or figuratively.)
m. (-लः)
1 The wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.)
2 The pomegranate.
3 Jujube.
4 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Mungo.)
f. (-ला)
1 Colocynth.
2 A pumpkin gourd.
3 The plantain.
4 The brown grape.
E.
सु good, फल fruit.

n. (-नं)
Cuttle-fish bone.
E.
सु good, फेन froth or foam.
